prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Photo-only website hero and interactive craftsmanship detail asset, landscape 1536 by 1024 pixels or larger.
Primary request: Create a new meticulous editorial photograph of a matte-black 19-inch network patch rack, with neatly parallel signal-red Ethernet patch leads and black hook-and-loop cable ties. The provided images are visual references only: use the network rack photo area as inspiration for color, lighting and composition, and ignore all website text, logos, controls, white UI and annotations.
Scene/backdrop: Clean commercial network cabinet, dark graphite metal, subtle realistic screws and vent perforations.
Subject: Two clearly defined rows of red RJ45 connectors plugged into black patch panels. Small evenly spaced natural hardware port markings can be visible but no brand names. Individual short red patch leads have smooth consistent downward bends. A thicker group of parallel red cables sweeps in a generous curve around the right side and horizontally across the lower third, kept orderly by three black hook-and-loop straps. The routing and connection points must be mechanically coherent, carefully separated and legible.
Style/medium: Premium real-world infrastructure photography, crisp close detail, authentic molded connector boots, soft grazing highlights on red cable jackets, tactile powder-coated black steel.
Composition/framing: Landscape close-up at a slight three-quarter angle, full photograph edge to edge. Both rows of ports occupy the left and center two thirds, broad cable management curve on the right, plenty of clear details at upper-left port marking, lower-center connector and right-hand cable sweep for future interactive HTML hotspots.
Lighting/mood: Controlled soft light, rich deep graphite shadows, restrained highlights, no strong blur, enough focus across the rack to see individual cables.
Constraints: Illustrative imagined installation, not documentation of Motexo work. PHOTO ONLY. No UI, logo, text headline, callout, hotspot, arrows, lines, branding, sign, watermark, border or composited screenshot. Do not reproduce website elements. No people. No loose tangled wires. No unsafe bare conductors.
